explication: PHP is a general-purpose scripting language interpreter. The principal workflow is a program entering through a PHP runtime interface, being compiled and executed by the engine, and producing output; the README describes PHP’s web-development focus and bundled extensions. The graph also preserves optimization, object handling, sessions, and random-number generation as distinct capabilities. Some internal workflow links are dashed because the excerpts do not show their dispatch or call sites; source-index references support the other cited relationships.
